title: DecisionUnlearn-Bench: Unlearning Probabilistic Decisions under Changing Schemas
abstract: arXiv:2610.38431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to reproduce the behavior of a model trained without designated data. For probabilistic decision models, this target also depends on the candidate options supplied at inference. We introduce DecisionUnlearn-Bench, an empirical framework that compares full, unlearned, and retain-only models across deletion granularities, label renderings, and candidate sets. Across 20 eligible model configurations on the BANKING77 dataset, full-to-oracle displacement increases consistently from example to association to class deletion. Replacing semantic option labels with opaque codes nearly eliminates the retrained oracle's recognition of deleted classes, even with successful acquisition of the full model, whereas changing the candidate set alters both the oracle and the measured unlearning progress. translated_title: DecisionUnlearn-Bench：模式变化下的概率决策遗忘
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在复现未使用指定数据训练的模型的行为。对于概率决策模型，这一目标还取决于推理时所提供的候选选项。我们提出了 DecisionUnlearn-Bench，这是一个实证框架，用于在删除粒度、标签呈现方式和候选集等多个维度上比较完整模型、遗忘模型与仅保留模型。在 BANKING77 数据集上的 20 个符合条件的模型配置中，从样例删除到关联删除再到类别删除，完整模型与重训练 Oracle 之间的偏差持续增大。用不透明的代码替换语义选项标签几乎消除了重训练 Oracle 对已删除类别的识别能力，即使完整模型被成功获取，而改变候选集则会同时改变 Oracle 以及所测得的遗忘进度。SimNPO 在 20 个配置中的 19 个满足了筛选标准，但其收益在不同随机种子和删除类型之间存在显著差异……
tldr: 该论文提出 DecisionUnlearn-Bench 基准，系统评估删除粒度、标签呈现方式与候选集变化对概率决策模型机器遗忘效果的影响，发现不透明标签编码会几乎消除重训练 Oracle 对已删除类别的识别、候选集变化会同时改变参照行为与遗忘进度，而 SimNPO 在 20 个配置中的 19 个通过筛选但对随机种子和删除粒度高度敏感。
en_tdlr: DecisionUnlearn-Bench empirically evaluates machine unlearning for probabilistic decision models across deletion granularities, label renderings, and candidate sets, showing that opaque label codes nearly eliminate the retrained oracle's recognition of deleted classes, changing candidate sets alters both the oracle and measured unlearning, and SimNPO satisfies the screening criterion in 19 of 20 configurations but varies substantially across seeds and deletion granularities.
